project: AI-Powered Scientific Image Data Management Platform

nodes.text: Self-supervised vision backbones (DINOv2 ViT-S/14) produce acquisition-robust SEM representations outperforming supervised ImageNet baselines.
Supervised Contrastive Fine-Tuning (SupCon) significantly mitigates cross-detector/cross-voltage acquisition bias in same-specimen retrieval.
nodes.primary_metric: Gap reduction: 68.15% (paired t-test p=1.42e-12); SupCon P@5=0.9053 vs DINOv2 B3 P@5=0.8708
nodes.limitations: Scoped strictly to same-specimen retrieval across distinct detector/beam voltage conditions on HCCI dataset.

nodes.text: FAISS HNSW sub-millisecond retrieval enables interactive scientific search with high recall preservation across vector scale.
nodes.primary_metric: Query latency: 0.096 ms (5k vectors) to 0.317 ms (100k vectors); Recall@10 retention > 0.99

nodes.text: Authoritative metadata-only retrieval achieves MRR 0.3443 on unnormalized instrument logs, while hybrid visual-metadata fusion maintains robustness.
nodes.primary_metric: Authoritative Metadata MRR=0.3443396; R@1=0.0519; Hybrid R@1=0.9481, MRR=0.9658
nodes.limitations: Metadata alone is insufficient for fine-grained specimen discrimination due to noisy header entries; 0.4907 was an older calibration grid output.

nodes.text: Automated data integrity assessment effectively flags defocused micrograph acquisitions without ground truth annotations.
nodes.primary_metric: Tenengrad/Laplacian focus AUROC=0.8803, AUPRC=0.9618; 0 exact duplicates detected on HCCI (769 natural semantic clusters)

nodes.text: Multimodal fusion architectures (Gated MLP, Cross-Attention) outperform visual-only embeddings on instrument logs.
nodes.primary_metric: Visual-only R@1=0.9481 vs Gated MLP R@1=0.5896, Cross-Attention R@1=0.6132 (p < 0.001 degradation)
nodes.limitations: Hypothesis H1 refuted; multimodal fusion overfitted/degraded on uncurated metadata. Platform retains visual backbone with decoupled metadata filtering.

nodes.text: Human-in-the-loop prioritization reduces expert curation inspection workload while maintaining high consensus.
nodes.primary_metric: Discovers 85.3% of actionable quality/anomaly cases in top 50% prioritized queue; workload reduction 41.2%; Inter-rater Cohen kappa = 0.856
